# Vendored front-end assets

Served from our own origin because the Content-Security-Policy allows scripts and fonts only
from `'self'`. Copied unmodified from npm (exact versions in `package.json`); refresh with
`npm run vendor`.

| File | Package | License |
|---|---|---|
| `gsap.min.js`, `ScrollTrigger.min.js` | gsap 3.15.1 | GSAP Standard "no charge" license, https://gsap.com/standard-license |
| `lenis.min.js` | lenis 1.3.27 | MIT, https://github.com/darkroomengineering/lenis |
| `fonts/bricolage-grotesque.woff2` | @fontsource-variable/bricolage-grotesque 5.3.0 (latin) | SIL Open Font License 1.1 |
| `fonts/atkinson-hyperlegible-next.woff2` | @fontsource-variable/atkinson-hyperlegible-next 5.3.0 (latin) | SIL Open Font License 1.1 |
